Name: PolyCarts - A complete Minecart overhaul
Author: Polydot
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/C2K4ksc.png[/img][/center]
You will need to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url] or [url=https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6/releases]Reset Terrain Features[/url] to remove the bushes blocking the minecarts on the farm. I can't do anything about this. You can find a guide [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2151]here![/url]
If you install the mod before starting a new save it will work without this.


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/kKnbhck.png[/img][/center]
[list]
[*]Each minecart destination starts out unknown, you have to find and interact with them before you can use them.
[*]The enchanted minecart realm, Expa, opens up for those in need. ([i]When you have at least one supported custom locations mod installed or reached Ginger Island you'll be able to switch between areas while keeping a tidy list of minecarts in each of them![/i])
[*]You can rename all minecarts so it's easier for you to know which is which.
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/zJgHeN2.png[/img][/center]
[i][color=#ea9999][center]You can undo all these changes[/center][/color][/i][list]
[*]The Bus stop minecart has been removed, as the new minecarts make it obsolete and it clogs the destination menu.
[*]The Town minecart has been renamed to fit the new format, the map for it has also been changed significantly.
[*]The Quarry minecart has been renamed to fit the new format, the map for it has been slightly tweaked to fit the mod's aesthetic.
[*]The Mine minecart has been untouched, as it is a perfect little baby.
[/list]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/wSXopwD.png[/img][/center]
You can unlock each minecart by finding them, this lists all of them so it might ruin some of the fun!
